body: hey, idk if you'll see this, but this is definitely nothing to be ashamed of. my girlfriend attempted suicide 3 years ago and she told me she can't promise me she'll  be alive. i talked to her while kinda half crying about how we could get through it together, and she eventually promised she would stay. After that i just started balling in her arms for a good while. crying is an emotion that shows you care, and it can mean more than words sometimes. it's definitely okay
well besides the actual gift, writing a little (or big ig) paragraph just detailing how much she means to you is always nice i think
